screens.text:
Every screen is in Quilter's Workbench (Nov 19).

Row 1 · Home and finding: Home, Your apps, Search, You, Reminder.
Row 2 · Clair: tap the Clair button, hold it to talk, tell and ask, data vs general questions, a photo with a question, share a file in, a fridge photo that asks what's low, what Clair remembers.
Row 3 · Demo path: Groceries, Review receipt, Budget, Calendar, Edit an item.
Row 4 · Clair builds an app: describe, pick a layout, arrange, connect and add, ready; Clair chat.
Row 5 · Apps made from blocks: Workout (5 tabs), Log a set, To-dos.
Row 6 · Laptop.
Row 7 · First open: onboarding, Welcome to second device.

The main button is Clair: one place to put anything in or ask anything, and it can land in several apps. A receipt is one example. Search is pull-down.

Words: Clair builds “apps”; sections inside an app are “tabs”. Buttons say what happens.

flows.text:
Click paths (press Play on any board)

Demo: Home > Clair > Photo > Review receipt > Add to 3 apps > See Budget ($412 → $376) > Calendar.

Clair: Home > Clair > “Spent $12 on lunch” > Add to 3 apps; the same sheet answers “Can I afford $60 concert tickets?” from Budget. Hold Clair to talk. File > a shared syllabus > Add to 2 apps.

Photo and ask: a photo with a question gets an answer, not a log (Clair offers “Log these items or just answer?”); receipts still go to Review receipt. Data answers cite your apps; general answers say so and offer a tracker.

Coming back: Home > Show 3 more > Clair's evening check-in > Review > Update 3 apps.

Build: Your apps > New app > Build it > pick a layout > Arrange or Use this layout > Add to my apps > ready.

Everywhere: the pinned bar (Budget, Groceries, Calendar, To-dos) and the Clair button.

onboarding.text:
First open (docs/onboarding.md). Press Play on Welcome and tap through.

Welcome > Start > What slips? (pick Money, Groceries, To-dos) > Make my apps > starter apps appear, pins fill (Calendar last) > Open Home > Clair button > Photo > camera pre-prompt > Continue > Review receipt (row 3: the first basted card) > Add to 3 apps (the first stitched moment).

Evening: check-in > Review > Remind me. Then Keep your quilt > Continue with Google > Add a device (code 482 913) > the laptop: type 482913 to join, anything else shows the error.

Branches: Skip on What slips? goes to the skipped-picks Home (the old Day one board, updated: no name, first prompt). Not now on the camera ask shows the camera-off line. No connection on first open: Try again.
